sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 240. Success value 100. 2x magic damage (Wind).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Removes status ailments.
-Target: all allies. Recovers 100% of max HP.
-Target: all allies. Reduces physical/magic damage taken to 0 (2 times).
-Target: all allies. Increases Cost recovery speed by 10 for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies resurrection.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 11000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies excluding yourself. Fills Unison gauge by 25.
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 3 for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 11000

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: yourself. Applies blessing (recovers 50 Cost, increases max HP by 100%, nullifies status ailments and Unison Gauge reduction effects, reduces cooldown times by 50%, and recovers 20% of max HP every 5 seconds) for 90 seconds.
Only [On Stage] EXPO 2021 Hatsune Miku can be used as Unlocking Potential material
